name: DeltaSplat
definition: A lightweight Gaussian refinement module for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that iteratively renders current Gaussians at input context views and predicts per-Gaussian updates from rendering residuals, conditioned on Plücker rays and rendered depth.
summary: DeltaSplat is a lightweight iterative refinement module for pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting that corrects errors by conditioning updates on per-pixel Plücker rays and rendered depth.
